row:
Central Texas College (CTC) offers a comprehensive array of associate degrees, vocational-technical, adult continuing education and high school programs in delivery formats that address virtually every need. 

All of us at CTC are especially proud to provide higher educational opportunities military members, veterans and their families at nearly 100 locations around the world and through our online programs.
